_doc: Stream E (owner feedback 8, W5: "ox carts at towns, and sometimes travelling the road, that act as PAID fast travel to other towns"). THE CARTERS. `rules` = how a ride works; `stops` = one per settlement of the province (a carter and a parked ox cart outside its main gate; x, z of a stop are WORLD metres like the routes file, `carter` and `cart` are ZONE metres like every placement — tools/content-hunts.mjs copies them into <zone>.quest.json as an `npc` row with role carter and a `cart` row, which is what the server spawns); `links` = which stops are joined directly (a road from data/provinces/torbor_downs-routes.json, or `overland: true` = a back lane the routes file does not list, at 1.3 x the straight line); `fares` = for every stop, every other stop with the road metres, the number of towns passed (`hops`), the first stop on the way (`next`) and the gold — already worked out with data/provinces/economy.json `cart` (cartFare = max(minGold, round(base + metres / metresPerGold))), so nothing computes a path at run time; `roaming` = the carts you meet on the road. Made by tools/content-towns.mjs; a test fails when the fares do not match economy.json.

service.name: the Longroad Carters
service.line: An ox does not hurry, but it does arrive.

rules.arriveAt: the cart of the stop you rode to
rules.mounted: you get down from your own mount first
rules.combat: not while you are in a fight
rules.party: each rider pays their own fare

refuse.gold: That is {fare} gold to {town}. Come back when you have it.
refuse.combat: Not with that after you. Lose it first.

says: Where to? The ox knows every road in the Downs.
rules._doc: A ride needs no waystone and no discovery (that is the point of it: it takes you somewhere you have never been). Talk to a carter (or use the cart) within boardM, pick a town, pay the fare, arrive beside that town cart after a short ride (rideSecPerKm x km of road, clamped to min/max — the client shows you on the cart). A `cart_token` good (the start chain gives one) pays any ONE fare.

roaming.takesYouTo: any stop, at the fare from the stop the cart is walking TO (its next town)
roaming.flagDown: use the carter or the cart while it is within rules.flagDownM; the group stops for you (stopNear)
roaming._doc: A few carts walk the real routes like any traveller. Flag one down and the same route window opens, priced from the town it is heading for.

runs.name: the Orrinsford run
runs._doc: A cart that is ALWAYS on the road between Torborhold and Orrinsford, so a newcomer walking the start chain meets one and a test can flag one down: a route of its own over the same road (`route` = the data/provinces/torbor_downs-routes.json id whose points it uses) on which ONLY `only` kinds walk. tests/E/playtest8-roaming.test.js walks a real cart along it and flags it down through js/sim/travellers.js + js/sim/carts.js. Ask of stream A (two lines, js/sim/content.js): add each run to `travel.routes` as { ...route, id, kinds: only, only: true } and do NOT append the wanderer kinds to a route with `only`.

made: tools/content-towns.mjs — stops, links, fares and problems are generated; edit rules / roaming by hand
